messages:
olivia: Quick idea  run a 10-day Mini HackRun for the Refkit community: 4 tiny tutorials + a "bring-your-own-model" benchmark lab. objective: 75 repo stars, 60 installs, and 40 bench submissions.
diego: love it. low-friction onboarding is key. propose: 1) quickstart tutorial, 2) routing & batching demo, 3) quantization cheat-sheet, 4) deploy-to-heroku style demo (cpu fallback).
tara: we'll need a single landing page + signup to collect benchmark URLs. prefer a lightweight form (email, github, region, use_case, benchmark_link, utm).
mike: for collection automation I'll add `submit_results.sh` and a tiny API endpoint that accepts `results.json`. example payload: `\{"user\":\"@alice\",\"model\":\"redwood-1.5b\",\"tokens\":1024,\"latency_ms\":48\}`. CLI: `./submit_results.sh results.json`.
olivia: community angle matters: theme "Ship a mini refapp in a morning" and badge for participants. prizes = community shoutout + sticker set.
zoe: social plan: 6 posts across X + Linkedin + a short YT clip. copy variants: technical (latency/cost numbers) vs story (what people built). i'll A/B via UTM.
diego: timeline: Day -7 assets & staging page up; Day 0 open signups + cohort email; Days 1-7 tutorials drip; Day 8 public demo + live Q&A.
tara: lead routing: HubSpot form -> tag `mini_hackrun_MAR` -> HubSpot list `mini-hackrun`. For benchmark submitters, trigger nurture flow: tips email + webinar invite.
mike: CI idea: GH Action `run-on-push` that runs a small smoke bench in `bench/ci` and produces `bench-summary.json`. users can `fork -> edit -> run` and paste link in the form.
olivia: copy needs: landing headline (60 char), short description (160 char), 3 social captions, blog post that includes our aggregated benchmark narrative. who owns writing? tara + diego.
zoe: creatives: hero GIF of a mini-refapp boot; 2 sequence cards (tutorials + results); vertical for stories. deliverable by Wed EOD.
diego: sample bench command for docs: `python -m refkit.bench --model redwood-1.5b --seq 256 --batch 4 --mode cpu` and sample output schema in docs.
tara: blog angle options: 1) "Mini HackRun: Build, Measure, Share" 2) "How community benchmarks taught us optimization tricks". prefer the former for social.
mike: analytics: track utm_source, utm_campaign=mini_hackrun_mar, bench_submitted=true. dashboard funnel: visit -> signup -> repo star -> bench submitted -> webinar attended.
olivia: owners & due dates: olivia = launch lead, diego = tutorials & tech docs (PR by Tue), tara = landing + blog (draft Mon), zoe = socials & assets (Wed), mike = infra & collectors (Mon).
build-bot: reminder scheduled: staging page must be accessible at 1713200000 for early tests.
olivia: incremental releases only for this thread after deadline. keep chatter to essentials. :sparkles:
diego: i'll prototype the repo layout: `/docs/tutorials/01-getting-started.md`, `/bench/runner.py`, `/examples/docker/` and a tiny `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
tara: let's also include a short checklist for participants to follow so we can count valid submissions: clone -> run -> submit link -> add `challenge` topic to their repo.
zoe: tweet example (short): "Mini HackRun: Ship a refapp + run a mini-benchmark. Get a badge. Sign up: <link>" longer thread will include a sample result.
mike: security note: make the submit API require a short token to avoid spam. we'll generate per-form submission or allow manual paste.
olivia: agree. final sync Friday 9am PT. I'll send calendar invite.
diego: PR-ing tutorial templates now.
tara: will post draft landing copy later today.
zoe: I'll upload social assets as `mini_hackrun-hero.gif` and cards by EOD Wed.
build-bot: webinar event created: "Mini HackRun Showcase" scheduled at 1713286400. invites sent.
